fields.description: Turns the Noviz AI chat page on/off for this site without removing the configuration.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The Noviz AI central server this site talks to, e.g. https://noviz.in
fields.label: Relay Base URL

fields.description: Issued once by Noviz AI at signup. Identifies THIS site as a tenant to the central relay - it is never used to access ERPNext data, only to authenticate this site's own requests to the relay API. Stored encrypted (Frappe's own Password fieldtype).
fields.label: Tenant API Key

fields.description: The scoped role real users must have to use the Noviz AI chat page. Created automatically on install - see hooks.py after_install.
fields.label: Agent Role

fields.description: Pick a module, then fill in its two boxes below. Switching this dropdown saves your edits into that module's own real record and loads whatever the newly-picked module already has - real data underneath, this is just how it's edited.
fields.label: Module
fields.options:
Selling
Buying
Accounting
HR / HRMS
Stock / Inventory
Manufacturing
Projects
Quality
Support
Assets
CRM

fields.description: One policy per line, as many lines as you need. The agent must refuse the action and explain why if any line here is violated. Example: "Never discount a first-time customer."
fields.label: Strict (must refuse if violated)

fields.description: One policy per line, as many lines as you need. The agent still proceeds, but flags it clearly to the person. Example: "Flag any leave request longer than 10 days."
fields.label: Warning (proceed, but flag it)

fields.description: Your own company's business policy, separate from the standard rules the agent already follows for every customer. One row per module - the real record behind the dropdown/boxes above. Editable directly here too if you prefer the grid view.
fields.label: Module Policies (all modules, grid view)
